[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior [[Jicoln Cadera]] swore an '''Oath of Brotherhood''' to the [[Clan Ordo|Ordo Clan]]. With the clan's sigil stamped in [[Gold/Legends|gold]], the [[Oath of Brotherhood|oath]] identified Cadera's place as a warrior within Clan Ordo, further validated by the swearer's signature of acceptance in [[Blood/Legends|blood]].
